posts.title: 0.8.260 is out — Windows and macOS
posts.body: Installers are up, carrying both of the last two rounds. The big one: time you spent writing could vanish instead of being saved. That is fixed.

posts.title: Videos: the craft, and building this thing in the open
posts.body: A YouTube channel where I talk about writing and about building Inkgrove — what it is for, and the parts of drafting nobody warns you about.

posts.title: It says beta now, and that is on purpose
posts.body: Same promise underneath: your writing stays on your machine, in files you own, with no account and no server holding any of it. If something breaks, say so.
